exact_source_references.source_document_title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.2.1-1.2.13 - clinic, ambulatory, and home blood-pressure assessment
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports documenting repeated clinic readings, ABPM or HBPM source and averages, result context, annual measurement in relevant diabetes care, and clinician review without automatically diagnosing hypertension.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.3.1-1.3.3 - cardiovascular risk and target-organ assessment
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports clinician-led cardiovascular-risk discussion and review of urine, blood, retinal, and ECG assessments where actually performed or already ordered.

exact_source_references.source_document_title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.4.15-1.4.24 - monitoring and annual review
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports clinic, home, or ambulatory blood-pressure monitoring, symptoms, medication and lifestyle discussion, and an annual review without generating targets, treatment, or advice.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.5.1-1.5.3 - severe hypertension and same-day specialist review features
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports documenting measured severe blood pressure plus assessed retinal, neurological, chest-pain, heart-failure, kidney-injury, or phaeochromocytoma features as prompts, never as automatic conclusions.

exact_source_references.source_organisation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
exact_source_references.source_document_title: Hypertension in adults: diagnosis and management

exact_section.heading: Recommendations 1.1.5–1.1.8 — postural hypotension symptoms and standing blood pressure
exact_section.evidence_summary: Supports documenting postural dizziness or falls context, lying or seated and standing blood pressure measurements, timing, symptoms, and clinician review without diagnosing orthostatic hypotension or changing treatment.
